raw.description:
mxdwn Games News Writers are expected to be on top of and keep up to date with what’s going on in the gaming industry on a daily basis. Writers are encouraged to go out and find the news that is relevant, fresh, and interesting to a broad gaming audience. They are expected to be able to research, source information, and then convey that news in a well structured, engaging article, on a 5 days a week basis.

To be successful in this position, you must:

  1. Have a passion for journalism, writing, and video games.
  2. Have a competent understanding of the English language including: grammar, flow, structure, and spelling.
  3. Have adequate time to properly research and write a cohesive article 5 times a week. (300 words minimum)
  4. Be able to work professionally with all members of the Games department.
  5. Have access to the internet and your own personal computer.

Please note that this is an UNPAID position.The benefits of joining the mxdwn Games team are experience, exposure, and a foot in the door into the industry.

No prior experience is required. A degree in Journalism, Creative Writing, or similar fields are a plus. If selected, you will receive training on how to write and publish a standard article using our site’s content management system.

mxdwn is an entertainment news site that brings its audience “all that matters in entertainment” across the board. As part of the mxdwn Games department, we strive to engage our audience with the most important, relevant, and varied content from an ever growing and evolving industry. We are currently looking for passionate writers with strong and varied interests in the video game industry and community.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking to grow our Talent Acquisition team, and we can’t do it without you. This team is paramount to the success of Avomind, and you’ll be supporting right at the heart of everything we do here - and how our business will be shaped for the future.

Are you passionate, committed, and eager to learn about the recruitment process? Wonderful — then we’re good to go.

raw.excerpt: ABOUT RENEW CAPITALRenew Capital is a pan-Africa investment firm with a presence in 13 countries.
raw.description:
ABOUT RENEW CAPITAL

Renew Capital is a pan-Africa investment firm with a presence in 13 countries. We back the bold founders using technology to pursue Africa’s greatest opportunities.

With more than a decade of investing on the continent, Renew Capital is among the most active investors building Africa’s thriving private sector.

Renew Capital is powered by a team of investment, finance, legal, advisory and market development professionals. Our bench includes seasoned investors, analysts, operators and ecosystem experts with deep experience scaling businesses across Africa.

ROLE SUMMARY

The sr. financial analyst plays a critical role in evaluating, supporting and scaling high-potential ventures across Africa. This role sits at the core of Renew Capital’s investment process, supporting sourcing, due diligence, investment decision-making and portfolio value creation.

The sr. financial analyst will work closely with investment managers, portfolio company CFOs and senior leadership, building rigorous financial models and translating complex data into clear insights that inform investment decisions.

Responsibilities:

The sr. financial analyst’s responsibilities are focused on three core areas:

1. Investment Analysis & Due Diligence

  • Prepare and maintain robust financial models for pipeline and prospective investment opportunities.
  • Analyze historical financial data, forecasts and assumptions to assess risk, return, and scalability.
  • Evaluate capital expenditures, depreciation schedules, and capital structuring scenarios.
  • Conduct market sizing, competitive analysis and primary and secondary research to support investment theses.
  • Support financial and commercial due diligence processes from initial screening through investment committee review.

2. Portfolio Support & Monitoring

  • Work directly with portfolio company finance teams on budgeting, 13-week rolling cash flow forecasts, and financial controls.
  • Monitor portfolio company performance, identify trends, calculate key ratios, and flag risks or opportunities early.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with portfolio CFOs and founders.

3. Communication & Insight Generation

  • Translate complex analysis into clear, decision-ready materials for investment managers, leadership and the investment committee.
  • Prepare presentations, memos and dashboards that communicate insights concisely.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, distributed investment team across Africa using digital tools.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business or a related field; MBA or Master’s in Finance preferred.
  • 6–8+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, investment analysis, private equity, venture capital, investment banking or corporate finance, with exposure to growth-stage companies.
  • Advanced financial modeling expertise, including integrated three-statement models, valuation, scenario and sensitivity analysis and capital structuring.
  • Strong experience supporting or leading financial and commercial due diligence processes.
  • Proven ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear, decision-ready insights for senior leadership and investment committees.
  • Excellent Excel and financial analysis skills, with experience working with large, complex data sets.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with investment teams, portfolio company CFOs and founders across diverse markets.
  • CFA or other recognized investment or financial modeling credentials preferred.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

As Renew Capital continues to expand its investment activity across Africa, strong financial analysis is essential to deploying capital responsibly and supporting portfolio companies through growth and complexity. This role provides exposure to venture investing across multiple sectors and markets, with the opportunity to influence real investment outcomes.

Location and Travel Opportunities:

This is a remote role; however, candidates must be based in Senegal.

About Renew Capital:

We invite you to learn more about Renew Capital by visiting our website:.

Application Process:

Renew Capital invites qualified applicants to fill out the application form on our website here.

Renew Capital is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran or disability status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Further, Renew Capital supports gender-based pay equity and is committed to compensating women and men equally, for equal work.

raw.description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Junior Proposal Manager to support the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) DCCO account. The successful candidate will assist in the planning, coordination, development, and submission of competitive federal proposals. This individual will work closely with Proposal Managers, Capture Managers, Business Development, Technical Leads, Pricing, Contracts, Recruiting, and other functional teams to ensure proposals are compliant, compelling, and submitted on schedule.

The Junior Proposal Manager will support multiple proposal efforts simultaneously and play an integral role throughout the proposal lifecycle, from pre-solicitation planning through final proposal submission. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Work Location: This is a fully telework position. Candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones are preferred.

Day to Day Work Responsibilities:

  • Support Proposal Managers throughout all phases of the federal proposal lifecycle, including pre-RFP planning, proposal development, production, and submission.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining proposal schedules, compliance matrices, action item trackers, and milestone calendars.
  • Track proposal assignments and follow up with contributors to ensure timely completion of deliverables.
  • Coordinate with technical subject matter experts, pricing, contracts, recruiting, graphics, production, and business development teams to collect proposal content.
  • Assist with proposal editing, formatting, document management, version control, and quality assurance reviews.
  • Support proposal compliance reviews to ensure all solicitation requirements are addressed.
  • Maintain proposal repositories, templates, lessons learned, and other proposal management documentation.
  • Prepare status reports and communicate proposal progress to leadership.
  • Support multiple concurrent proposal efforts while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of business development and proposal operations.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree and 2 years of experience, or a High School diploma/equivalent and 6 years of experience
  • U.S. Citizenship is required with the ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance
  • Experience coordinating multiple proposal activities and meeting aggressive deadlines.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Microsoft Teams.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting federal government proposals, RFP responses, RFIs, or other government solicitation responses.
  • Familiarity with the federal proposal lifecycle, including compliance matrices, proposal schedules, and color team reviews.
  • Experience coordinating proposal inputs and deliverables across cross functional teams.
  • Experience developing proposal schedules, action item trackers, compliance matrices, and other proposal documentation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft SharePoint and other collaboration or proposal management tools.
  • Familiarity with Shipley proposal development methodologies and federal contracting terminology.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$66,000 - $106,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

Start your journey with BCD: Grow, connect, collaborate and celebrate with our global team

Senior Manager, Product Planning- Hotel Content (Remote)

Full-time, United Kingdom, Ireland, Netherlands, Poland, Costa Rica, India, France, Germany, Poland, Denmark, Spain, United States

The Hotel Content Senior Manager will be responsible for integrating, managing, and optimizing hotel content on our platform. The person will play a critical role in modernizing the Hotel APIs and ensuring that the content is efficiently integrated, maintained, and optimized for our Point of Sale (POS) channels.

This role will be focused on optimizing the hotel shopping and booking experience by enhancing current capabilities as well as improving retailing and content presentation.

This position will require managing the lifecycle of product investments from proof of concept to the final implementation and being responsible for ensuring that product solutions are well-defined, feasible, properly resourced, and documented, with strong alignment to business goals.

The Hotel Content Senior Manager requires a deep understanding of the hotel industry, strong analytical skills, and a user experience-focused mindset to continuously analyze content performance and recommend strategies to improve and optimize hotel shopping and booking capabilities.

The role leads the product planning efforts for assigned solutions. It takes full responsibility for the product road maps and their delivery globally, including the development of the go-to-market approach and market penetration. The role partners with and influences stakeholders internally and externally to identify, shape, and deliver products that focus on increasing revenue streams for our Hotel product. Key within this role is integrating, managing, and optimizing hotel content.

As a Senior Manager, Product Planning- Hotel Content, you will

  • Provide integration and management of Hotel APIs to ensure that the content is correctly structured, normalized, and distributed, including the API modernization projects
  • Identify and implement new features or enhanced capabilities based on customer feedback, market demand, and business priorities
  • Analyze existing hotel workflows, systems, and processes to identify areas for increased efficiency and optimization
  • Make sure your assigned products have sound business plans, including an analysis of product profitability, sales success, and pricing strategy
  • Develop and present a comprehensive business case for a proposed product investment, including cost-benefit analysis, ROI projections, and strategic alignment
  • Building relationships with our vendors and suppliers; listen to their thoughts and concerns and foster ways to work together

About you

  • Knowledge of the hotel industry, including key players, market trends, and consumer behavior
  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of APIs and hotel booking systems, especially Sabre and Amadeus GDS, and how they integrate with booking platforms
  • Experience in business travel and/or travel management
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You'll interact with a variety of partners and will need a high level of comfort in communicating with professionals of different backgrounds
  • Competency with Microsoft Office Products and collaborative software used for projects with remote team members and stakeholders
  • Data analytical skills

What we offer you

At BCD Travel, we work with highly motivated and passionate people. We value open communication, collaboration, and a flexible work-life balance. We offer unique, often global, experiences that empower you to develop and grow within the organization. Sustainability and helping others is also high on our list. We make a difference through charitable activities in our communities across the globe.

About us

BCD Travel helps companies travel smart and achieve more. We drive program adoption, cost savings and talent retention through digital experiences that simplify business travel. Our 15,000+ dedicated team members service clients in 170+ countries as we shape a sustainable future for business travel. BCD’s leading meetings and events management and global consultancy services complete our comprehensive suite of solutions for all aspects of corporate travel. In 2024, BCD achieved US$22.9 billion in sales. For more information, visit www.bcdtravel.com.

Get to know us by reading our blog and checking out our social media:

You’ll be offered

  • Flexible working hours and work-from-home or remote opportunities
  • Opportunities to grow your skillset and career
  • Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge
  • A compensation package that feels fair to you, including mental, physical, and financial wellbeing tools
  • Travel industry professional perks and discounts
  • An inclusive work environment where diversity is celebrated

At BCD Travel, we value you—our culture and success are defined by our people. We carefully consider a wide range of objective, gender‑neutral compensation factors, including professional background, skills, experience, and role scope.

This position is advertised across multiple global locations. The expected annual gross salary ranges by country are as follows:

  • Spain: 58,000- 63,000 EUR
  • France: 74,000 - 83,000 EUR
  • Poland: 170,000 - 185,000 PLN
  • Germany: 67,000 - 86,000 EUR
  • Netherlands: 75,000- 80,000 EUR
  • Ireland: 80,000 - 82,000 EUR
  • United States: 100,000 - 118,000 USD

The final salary offered will ultimately depend on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and location, and will be determined in line with internal equity.

We do not request salary history and are committed to equal pay in line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

Ready to join the journey? Apply now!

Senior Database Reliability Engineer:

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Job Summary:

Join our team as a Senior Database Reliability Engineer, where you’ll play a central role in architecting, optimizing, and ensuring the stability of mission-critical PostgreSQL environments. You will leverage your deep technical expertise to drive database reliability, high availability, and performance at scale within a cutting-edge, cloud-native infrastructure. This is an excellent opportunity for talented engineers who are passionate about building robust data systems and thrive in collaborative, fast-paced environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and manage highly available, resilient PostgreSQL database architectures using AWS RDS and Aurora PostgreSQL.
  • Optimize database performance by analyzing query execution plans, tuning indices, and implementing advanced partitioning strategies.
  • Ensure disaster recovery readiness through robust backup, replication, and failover processes.
  • Diagnose and resolve slow queries, locks, deadlocks, and complex bottlenecks impacting large-scale databases.
  • Automate routine maintenance tasks and promote operational excellence across all database environments.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to support new features, data migrations, and ongoing application scaling.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation and demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience managing and optimizing PostgreSQL databases in production settings.
  • Expert-level knowledge of PostgreSQL internals, query tuning, indexing, partitioning, and replication.
  • Proven hands-on experience with AWS RDS and Aurora PostgreSQL, including backup, recovery, and high-availability design.
  • Strong analytical abilities in troubleshooting slow queries, execution plans, locks, and deadlocks.
  • Demonstrated experience maintaining large-scale, high-traffic databases with millions of rows.
  • Deep care for clear, proactive written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a remote team.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting data platforms, analytics workloads, ETL processes, and operational databases.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native service environments.
  • Exposure to supporting modern data architectures and advanced monitoring tools.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Silvus Technologies, a leading provider of advanced MANET and MIMO communications systems, is reshaping mesh network technology for mission-critical applications – on the ground, in the air and at sea. Its battle-proven StreamCaster family of MANET radios and proprietary MN-MIMO waveform provides the vital communications link for defense, law enforcement and public safety agencies around the world, and in the toughest operational environments.

With deep roots in DARPA research, Silvus Technologies develops world-class advanced communications technologies that are reshaping the tactical communications landscape. From pure line-of-sight to extreme non-line-of-sight, Silvus radios form a self-healing, self-forming mesh network, enabling secure and reliable connectivity, including video and high-bandwidth data.

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.


Job Description

THE OPPORTUNITY

Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”?

Silvus is seeking a Market Development Executive, U.S. Air Force & Space Force who will report to the Vice President of Strategic Growth on the Sales team. The successful individual in this role will serve as Silvus’ senior market-shaping leader across the air and space enterprise. This role is responsible for influencing capability requirements, strengthening advocacy within major modernization and advanced battle management programs, and driving long-term strategic engagement across AFLCMC, Space Systems Command, operational wings, and mission partners, while also providing supervisory responsibility overseeing the strategic program pursuits of the USAF BD Director.

This position is not transactional sales. Instead, this is a strategic influence role - focused on shaping demand, positioning Silvus Technologies early in emerging programs, and ensuring transitions to Business Development and Capture teams for downstream execution.

This position is eligible for 100% remote work depending on location with a preference for this individual to have proximity to key USAF commands. This role also includes travel requirements of up to 50% as needed, to maintain strong customer engagement and relationships.

Your Job as a Substance Use Counselor:

The Substance Use Counselor is instrumental in our patient’s treatment and recovery from opioid use disorder. Substance Use Counselors provide high quality, compassionate care through various mediums which include both individual and group counseling sessions.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Provide high quality, compassionate guidance in both individual and group counseling sessions.

raw.description:
Our Company

SpringHealth Behavioral Health and Integrated Care

Overview

WE WANT YOU ON OUR TEAM!

Apply today if you are passionate about assisting a population with

Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities reach their highest level of independence!

The ideal candidate will work mainly with the process of FBAs in a remote setting.

Qualifications: Must be a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA).

Must have experience implementing Applied Behavior Analysis programming with behavioral intervention.

Available to work until 8:00pm PST.

At SpringHealth, we provide services for children and adults, using positive programming and non-aversive strategies to deliver the best quality support. Our services are tailored to meet the unique needs of individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD), intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD), or mental illness to help them achieve their best overall health and well-being.

Our evidence-based programs and therapies are designed to give youth and adults more positive, active, and social lives. We conduct appointments in various locations. These include residential homes, schools, family homes, workplaces, and other community-based settings.

Some of the things our clinicians love about working for SpringHealth are:

  • Remote and Hybrid schedule opportunities
  • The ability to work from home when not in session.
  • Flexible Work Schedule
  • Opportunity for Advancement
  • Great work/life balance
  • Opportunity to work with multiple populations including adults and youth.

Responsibilities

  • Conducts ongoing assessments to meet the needs of patients served.
  • Communicates between supervisors, direct care staff members, family members, guardians, and collateral individuals regarding an individual's progress.
  • Provides a monthly schedule to supervisors of appointments, home visits, and observations to monitor work advancement.
  • Coordinates home, work and/or community-based visits to meet the requirements of observations, chart reviews, staff interviews, and data analysis.
  • Ensures the Behavior Intervention plan is implemented effectively and properly.
  • Participates in Interdisciplinary Team Meetings and other pertinent meetings as required.
  • Completes monthly and/or quarterly progress notes.
  • Organizes training to certify staff and other team members are competent in the implementation of the Behavior Intervention Plan and/or documentation sheets.
  • Provides follow-up interviews, home visits, and observations for continued support of an individual's needs.
  • Maintains strong clinical records to guarantee information is readily available to interested parties.
  • Acts as liaison with the public and mental health community to support development of ongoing goals.
  • Assists in creating procedures for training materials to improve programs for individuals served.
  • Complete continued education on behaviorally based interventions & techniques to stay competitive in the field.

Qualifications

  • Must have experience with behavioral intervention and/or strong educational emphasis on learning and developmental psychology.
  • Two or more years of experience working with individuals with developmental disabilities or behaviorally challenged population.
  • Must have reliable transportation.
  • Ability to perform physical tasks, including standing for extended periods, bending, move from seated to standing regularly.

  • State Specific Requirements:

    • Illinois: Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBA), Licensed Clinical Psychologist, Board Certified Associate Behavior Analyst (BCaBA), or a minimum of a bachelor’s degree with 1500 hours of supervised experience performed by a Licensed Psychologist or BCBA.
    • Indiana: A master’s degree in a human related field (this includes but is not limited to BCBA, Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Counselor)
    • Kentucky: A master’s degree in a human related field and 2 years of experience (this includes but is not limited to BCBA, Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Counselor)
    • Georgia: Master’s degree in psychology, special education, counseling, social work, or related field OR BCBA, Licensed Professional Counselor, Licensed Clinical Social Worker, or Licensed Psychologist/Psychiatrist. All applicants MUST have at least 2 years of experience providing positive behavioral supports (writing BSP, functional assessment; plan development, training, and implementation) to people with intellectual and/or developmental disabilities. Must have documented coursework in Applied Behavior Analysis reflected on resume or transcript.
    • California: Must be a BCBA or BCaBA.
    • Virginia: BCBA, BCaBA, Licensed Psychologist or Positive Behavior Support Specialist Facilitator (PBSF), LPC, LSW or LCSW with training and experience and/or documented coursework in Applied Behavior Analysis reflected on resume or transcript.
    • Texas: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Psychological Associate, Licensed Clinical Social Worker, Licensed Professional Counselor, or BCBA

About our Line of Business

SpringHealth Behavioral Health and Integrated Care, an affiliate of BrightSpring Health Services, offers a holistic approach and integrated care for people with cognitive, developmental, or intellectual disabilities who often need additional resources. The behavior analysts, therapists, social workers, counselors, and psychologists at SpringHealth combine their expertise to deliver high-quality behavioral services for clients to live more positive, active, and social lives. For more information, please visit www.springhealthbehavioral.com. Follow us on Facebook and LinkedIn.

raw.description:
The salary range for this role is $2,800 - $6,000 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this mid-level development role, with 3-7 years of experience, the compensation range is $2,800 - $6,000 USD per month. This range is designed to reflect the skills, experience, and value brought to the team, ensuring competitive and fair pay within the industry.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Software Engineer II who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. As a Software Engineer II, you will be responsible for solving our most challenging problems along with a highly-motivated team.

In this role, you will work closely with other engineers across multiple teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative products. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include partnering with other engineers to design, develop, and deliver new features. As your skills grow so will the size and scope of the projects which you’ll be involved in. Sezzle has a strong culture for promotion with defined paths through Engineering that matches all levels. You’ll be working as part of a full-stack Engineering team which has varied disciplines.

What You'll Do:

  • Build and maintain new innovative product features focused on actively learning new areas of the product
  • Collaborate with owners for different product features to gain insight and offer constructive suggestions for improvements
  • Be an active participant in design/architecture discussions sharing your ideas while building the next generation of features for the Sezzle platform
  • Hands-on with our codebase and a contributor to code reviews
  • Mentor other engineers who are starting along their career path
  • Work with the team to continuously build and deploy scalable solutions
  • Assist in planning, estimations, and completion for projects brought up by the team stakeholders
  • Be on a on-call rotation to respond to production incident.

What We Look For:

  • Experience solving technical problems as part of a team
  • Familiarity with modern Frontend Development, with React experience preferred
  • Ability to solve problems with backend-focused languages like Go or similar compiled statically typed language
  • Intermediate understanding of relational databases like MySQL
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Knowledgeable in writing automated tests for applications (unit, integration, end-to-end)
  • Familiar with the basic principles and design of RESTful APIs
  • Basic knowledge of a Microservice Architecture
  • Close familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

The Director, Project Engineering is responsible for planning, developing, and executing the capital expenditure (CapEx) program across a region of bakeries. This role provides project leadership from concept through commissioning, ensuring all projects meet budget, schedule, quality, and safety objectives.

• Ensure projects are delivered on-time, within budget, and in compliance with food safety and regulatory standards.

• Implement project management best practices including scope, risk, and change management.
• Provide leadership and coaching to project engineers and support staff.

• Ensure compliance with all company policies and procedures (EEO, Sexual Harassment, Sarbanes – Oxley, Safety, etc.)
• Perform other duties which are deemed to be an integral part of the position, including but not limited to fulfillment of work schedules, adherence to attendance policies, and other applicable operating rules, policies, and procedures

• Minimum of 12+ years of experience managing large capital projects in food manufacturing or industrial bakery operations
• Master’s degree in Engineering or a related field preferred
• Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification preferred
• Demonstrated expertise in project controls, cost management, and scheduling
• Strong vendor and contractor management skills
• Knowledge of food safety, OSHA, and environmental compliance

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field required

raw.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

We're hiring a Director of Compensation to own our broad-based comp strategy end-to-end. This is a senior people leadership role reporting to the Head of Total Rewards. You’ll drive the programs, frameworks, and cross-functional partnerships that keep our pay competitive and fair as we grow into new markets. This role sits at the intersection of people strategy and business partnership, and the person who fills it will have a direct line of sight to how we attract, retain, and motivate the talent that powers Instacart's growth.

What you'll cook up in your first year

Our annual and mid-year comp cycles run with greater precision and speed. You own the design and delivery end-to-end and have raised the quality bar even as scope and complexity have grown.

Work closely with HR Business Partners, Finance, Legal, and senior business leaders to solve hard problems and give them recommendations they can act on. You'll weigh in on executive offers, retention decisions, org changes, pay equity question, and stand behind difficult calls in gray areas.

Instacart's equity compensation approach is competitive and forward-looking. You deeply understand the market landscape and drive meaningful changes to how we design and communicate equity.

You lead a high-performing team of compensation business partners. You set clear direction, high standards, and cultivate an environment where people do their best work.

You carry individual contributor responsibilities as a compensation business partner to help you stay close to evolving business needs. Scale your experience to coach your team.

Lead our international expansion compensation work. Build the frameworks, market data, and guidance needed to pay people competitively and compliantly as we expand into new countries.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience supporting Sales/GTM client groups alongside R&D.

raw.description:
Votre rôle

En tant que Ingénieur Avant-vente au sein de la Direction Défense et Sécurité, vous serez responsable de construire les solutions technologiques de nos grand s clients en équipe avec les Business Manager et les autres Business Unit d’Orange Business.

Votre maîtrise des technologies Cloud, Digital, Data et IA vous permettent d’accompagner nos clients dans la définition, la mise en œuvre et l'exploitation de solutions adaptées à leurs besoins métiers, et conformément leurs exigences réglementaires en matière de souveraineté et de développement durable.

MISSIONS / ACTIVITES  :

Au sein de la Direction Intégration et Services Digitaux, vous travaillerez dans un environnement technologique stimulant, où vous avez pour missions :

  • Prendre en charge et piloter les dossiers d'avant-vente en collaboration avec la force de vente, depuis la phase de prospection jusqu'au transfert des éléments aux opérationnels ;
  • Être force de proposition quant à la construction d'offres techniques et de services novatrice en lien avec les besoins de nos clients ; 
  • Rédiger les réponses en s'appuyant sur les interlocuteurs adéquats en interne et en respectant les délais, les règles de délégation et les standards pour la rédaction des offres ; 
  • Garantir la faisabilité et de la cohérence technique et organisationnelle des solutions proposées aux clients.

De manière concrète, vos activités porteront sur :

  • Accompagner les commerciaux lors des différentes phases de vente en fournissant un appui technique ;
  • Etablir et maintenir une communication efficace et positive avec les clients pour développer une compréhension profonde de leurs besoins et attentes, et pour construire une relation de confiance dans la durée ;
  • Qualifier les opportunités et préparer les éléments de décision Bid / No Bid : estimations (charges & achats), risques majeurs (techniques / contractuels / financiers) ; 
  • Élaborer des réponses sur le plan fonctionnel, technique, organisationnel et budgétaire, en lien avec les architectes, consultants, chefs de projet et commerciaux en fonction du cahier des charges et du contexte client ;
  • Comparer nos solutions/architectures par rapport aux solutions concurrentes ; 
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes techniques pour établir la solution technique, le plan de charge et la planification projet ;
  • Etablir le P&L projet en collaborant avec l'équipe de contrôle de gestion pour l'établissement pour les offres le nécessitant ;
  • Coanimer la réunion de décision de validation de l'offre avec le management habilité, avant sa transmission au Client ;
  • Soutenir l'offre avec l’ingénieur commercial lors des différentes phases de la négociation (technique et commerciale) ;
  • Réaliser la réunion de présentation d’offre aux équipes en charge de la réalisation des projets gagnés.

 

Votre profil

De formation Bac+4/+5, vous êtes passionné(e) par votre métier et possédez une expérience significative similaire (5 ans minimum).

  • Vous êtes technophile et orienté client. Vous êtes bon communiquant et disposez d'un leadership affirmé ;
  • Votre sens du collectif, vos capacités à fédérer, à innover, à se différencier, sont les clés de votre réussite sur ce poste ;
  • Vous avez une culture technique ou des connaissances dans les domaines suivants : Digital, Data, IA, … ;
  • Vous maitrisez ces domaines auprès de partenaires technologiques leaders sur ces marchés.

COMPETENCES CIBLES  :

  • Vous êtes curieux(se) et avez l'esprit ouvert ;
  • Vous savez développer l'esprit d'équipe et la transversalité ;
  • Vous savez collaborer avec des équipes d'experts et de commerciaux pour proposer des solutions adaptées aux besoins des clients ;
  • Vous êtes autonome et capable de vous adapter à différentes situations ;
  • Vous savez gérer efficacement les délais et la pression ;
  • Vous êtes orienté(e) client et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement commercial ;
  • Vous avez une très bonne capacité rédactionnelle et vous êtes à l'aisance à l'oral ;
  • Vous avez une appétence pour les montages financiers ;
  • Vous possédez de fortes capacités de synthèse afin de favoriser une prise de décision de la chaine managériale et des clients ;
  • Vous avez une culture technique et des connaissances approfondies dans les domaines suivants : Digital, Data, IA ;
  • Une maitrise d'Excel reste une valeur sure, malgré l’avènement de la digitalisation ;
  • La pratique de l'anglais (oral/écrit) serait un plus apprécié.

 

Ce poste nécessite des accréditations spécifiques à la protection du secret de la défense nationale pour travailler sur des projets sensibles. Le candidat devra se soumettre à ces procédures. L’obtention de ces accréditations est un pré-requis.

Entité

L’ambition d’Orange Business est de devenir l’intégrateur réseaux et numérique de référence en Europe, en nous appuyant sur nos forces autour des solutions de connectivité nouvelle génération, du cloud et de la cybersécurité.

Nos 30 000 femmes et hommes présents dans 65 pays, dont chaque voix compte, sont tous animés par la même détermination et le même esprit d’équipe, pour construire les solutions digitales d’aujourd’hui et de demain et créer un impact positif pour nos clients, pour leurs salariés et pour la planète. Nous offrons des opportunités passionnantes grâce à des projets innovants dans la data et le digital, le cloud, l’IA, la cybersécurité, l’IoT, ou encore le digital workspace et le big data.

Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous !

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are hiring a hands-on, builder-focused Project Manager for AI Transformation to optimize our content production and growth marketing operations. In this role, you will design, prototype, and scale AI-assisted workflows to eliminate operational bottlenecks and accelerate how we bring growth funnels to market. This is an excellent opportunity to bridge the gap between creative teams, automation tools, and rapid pipeline execution.

Please Note: This is not a "pure PM" coordination or administrative role. We are looking for an execution-focused professional who can actively build and prototype workflows independently, and comfortably operate within undefined operational environments.

What you will do

  • Design & Implement AI Workflows: Architect, prototype, and scale end-to-end AI-assisted workflows for content production and asset localization.
  • Execute Growth Funnel Operations: Configure and maintain interactive growth funnel assembly lines using tools such as Lovable, Typeform, and ManyChat.
  • Deploy AI Pipelines: Launch and optimize practical AI pipelines across CRM systems, creative generation, messaging channels, and asset production.
  • Streamline Delivery Pipelines: Coordinate fast-moving schedules and manage operational dependencies across the Copy, Design, CRM, and Growth teams.
  • Process Optimization: Audit legacy content production workflows and simplify complex, manual processes into lean, repeatable steps.
  • Tooling & Vendor Management: Evaluate, integrate, and manage our ecosystem of no-code platforms, generative AI interfaces, and third-party operational vendors.
  • Define Operational Analytics: Establish operational metrics and transformation reporting to track pipeline velocity and efficiency gains.

Requirements

  • Proven Operational Experience: 3+ years of experience in project management, operations management, or growth operations, specifically handling high-volume delivery pipelines.
  • Hands-on No-Code Automation: Demonstrated capability to independently build, test, and deploy complex workflow automations using platforms like n8n, Make, or Zapier.
  • Practical AI Application: Direct proficiency engineering prompts and structuring workflows using foundational models (OpenAI, Claude) to solve real-world operational friction points.
  • Process Architecture Skills: A proven track record of taking unorganized, highly manual workflows and successfully re-engineering them into clear, streamlined processes.
  • Ambiguity Tolerance & Pragmatism: Comfortable operating without pre-existing blueprints; highly realistic about the current limitations of AI and expert at balancing speed against quality.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Strong communication skills with a history of successfully aligning creative (Copy, Design) and analytical (CRM, Growth) teams.
  • Language: Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Interactive Tooling Mastery: Prior experience configuring and managing user journeys within Lovable, Typeform, and ManyChat frameworks.
  • Creative AI Pipeline Experience: Familiarity with AI creative tools (video generation, automated image manipulation, or voice/audio workflows).
  • Growth Marketing Knowledge: Clear understanding of automated CRM workflows, behavioral triggers, and localized content delivery mechanisms.

What we can offer you

  • High autonomy to explore, test, and improve processes.
  • Competitive compensation.
  • Fully remote collaboration.
  • Work alongside an experienced, global professional team.
  • A digital office — we use modern tools (Notion, Miro, Slack, Figma) to keep collaboration smooth.
  • Professional trust and autonomy — no micromanaging.

The Field Marketing Manager, North America is a results-driven marketer responsible for developing and executing strategic marketing plans with a portfolio of key partners. This individual contributor role combines partner relationship management, integrated marketing strategy, and hands-on execution to drive partner engagement, demand generation, pipeline growth, and measurable business impact.

Working closely with Channel Sales, regional marketing, Product Marketing, and Global Demand Generation, this role translates business priorities and corporate campaigns into tailored, partner-specific plans. The ideal candidate is a collaborative, data-driven marketer who can build trusted relationships, identify growth opportunities, and manage multiple strategic partner plans from strategy through measurement.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Partner Marketing Plans

  • Own the development, execution, and optimization of annual and quarterly marketing plans for assigned strategic partners across North America.
  • Partner with Channel Account Managers and partner stakeholders to align joint marketing priorities with revenue goals, growth opportunities, customer segments, and go-to-market strategies.
  • Build tailored, integrated marketing plans that may include digital campaigns, content, webinars, enablement, account-based tactics, customer advocacy, and selective events.
  • Develop strong relationships with partner marketing contacts and serve as their primary marketing point of contact.

Integrated Campaign Development and Execution

  • Translate global campaigns, messaging, and content into relevant co-marketing initiatives for strategic partners and their target audiences.
  • Coordinate campaign development and execution across paid, owned, earned, and partner-led channels.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external agencies to deliver campaign assets, content, communications, and partner enablement materials on time and on brand.
  • Support partner recruitment, cross-sell, upsell, and customer acquisition objectives through targeted marketing strategies.

Sales and Partner Alignment

  • Work closely with Channel Sales to understand partner business needs, identify marketing opportunities, and maintain alignment on priorities and expected outcomes.
  • Provide partners and internal stakeholders with clear plans, timelines, performance updates, and recommendations.
  • Gather partner feedback and market insights to improve campaigns, partner experience, and go-to-market effectiveness.

MDF and Budget Management

  • Manage assigned marketing development funds and program budgets with accuracy, transparency, and strong investment stewardship.
  • Ensure partner activities meet funding requirements, brand standards, and business objectives.
  • Track spend, forecasts, and results, recommending adjustments to improve performance and return on investment.

Performance Measurement

  • Define success metrics for each partner marketing plan and track engagement, demand, marketing-influenced pipeline, and revenue contribution.
  • Use campaign and partner performance data to identify trends, optimize tactics, and share actionable insights.
  • Maintain accurate reporting in CRM, marketing automation, and partner marketing systems.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Global Demand Generation, Global Events, Product Marketing, Channel Programs, Brand/Creative, PR, and Social Media to deliver coordinated partner campaigns.
  • Share best practices, partner insights, and successful approaches across the field and partner marketing organization.
  • Contribute to a consistent, high-quality partner experience while adapting plans to individual partner needs and market opportunities.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in field marketing, channel marketing, partner marketing, or demand generation, preferably within technology, cybersecurity, IT, or SaaS.
  • Experience developing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic partners and delivering measurable business results.
  • Strong understanding of integrated B2B marketing, including digital campaigns, content, webinars, account-based marketing, and partner-led demand generation.
  • Experience managing MDF or marketing budgets, campaign timelines, agencies, and multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Working knowledge of CRM, marketing automation, and analytics platforms; experience with Salesforce, Marketo, and ABX tools is preferred.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Analytical and results-oriented, with the ability to translate performance data into clear recommendations.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Understanding of the MSP or channel ecosystem is preferred.

Key Attributes

  • Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach to execution.
  • Partner-focused and skilled at building trusted, productive relationships.
  • Collaborative, accountable, and comfortable influencing without direct authority.
  • Curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement.

Why Work for WatchGuard?

WatchGuard is a global leader in network security and intelligence, advanced endpoint protection, multi-factor authentication, and secure Wi-Fi. Our award-winning products and services are trusted worldwide by more than 18,000 security resellers and service providers to protect more than 250,000 customers. Our technology keeps our customers ahead of increasingly sophisticated hackers and has fueled record revenues at WatchGuard.

WatchGuard is headquartered in Seattle, Washington, with team members working remotely and in offices worldwide.

Our company culture places an intense focus on our customers and employees. From the newest employee to our CEO, you'll find that each person at WatchGuard embodies our Core Values: Accountability, Community, Belonging, Action, Innovation, and Customer-Centric. Learn more about our company culture at .

Our equal employment opportunity (or EEO) policy focuses solely on the talent, hard work, contributions, and actual results achieved by each WatchGuard employee and on the potential of employment candidates to make such contributions. We consider focusing on an employee's protected characteristics rather than on talent, hard work, and actual work results to violate our EEO policy. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we are committed to a diverse workforce. WatchGuard participates in E-verify.

raw.description:
Why NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture:

At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.

Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

As a Salesforce Architect focused on Agentforce, you will be responsible for building compelling Agentforce-powered experiences for users and delivering impactful business value to our clients. You'll have the opportunity to make significant contributions to our success by working with the rest of our talented AI team to delight customers. This position is focused on architecting and executing technical solutions for Agentforce and related-technologies.

You will have the opportunity to:

  • Lead and own the technical solution design. This includes designing and understanding the complete Agentforce solution which includes topics, instructions, actions with corresponding automation/code, agent deployment methods, and supporting data structures.
  • Deep dive into the limits and boundaries of Agentforce Agents, finding novel solutions to drive business outcomes.
  • Collaborate with customers, Project Managers, Solution Architects, Developers and UX Designers to translate business needs into well-architected solutions
  • Oversee and contribute to all stages of the project lifecycle—from initial design through development, testing, and final deployment
  • Follow and understand new Salesforce products and technical capabilities

Required Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of experience in application and software development
  • 4+ years of experience with Salesforce in a development role
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • Proficiency in Apex and JavaScript, with exposure or working knowledge of modern coding languages (e.g. Python, Java, C#)
  • Experience developing Salesforce technologies including Flows, Lightning Web Components, or Visualforce
  • Understanding of front-end web development principles and technologies (HTML/CSS)
  • Strong communication skills; the ability to convey complex technical details to all audiences
  • Experience with using source control and branching/pull requests strategies
  • Familiarity with CI/CD solutions and DevOps principles

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience working with Agentic AI Systems and Generative AI capabilities
  • Any additional Salesforce certifications are a plus, preferably Platform Developer II or Agentforce Specialist certifications

What can you expect in the interview process?

  • Recruiter screen (phone) - 30 minutes
    • Introductory conversation to discuss the role and your experience
  • Panel Interview with Real-Time Exercise (Video) - 60 minutes
    • The call will be split into two parts:
      • You’ll receive a prompt and talk through potential solution options and live on the spot (no offline preparation required)
      • You’ll get some time to interact with NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture delivery team members
  • Organization lead interview (Video) - 45 minutes
    • You’ll talk through your career goals and relevant work examples
    • You’ll discuss challenges you have overcome and the tools you used to get there
  • Leadership interview (Video) - 45 minutes
    • You’ll meet with a member of our leadership team

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

  • Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
  • Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
  • Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done

We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

As part of Tenstorrent’s Automotive Robotics team, you will help design and deliver the core hardware modules inside our next generation chiplet based SoCs for automotive products. You will be the bridge between silicon design, DFT, OSAT partners, and customers to ensure our multi die SiP platforms meet aggressive performance, quality, and safety targets.

This role is remote, based in Munich, Germany.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

  • Experienced with industry standard ATPG and DFx insertion CAD tools.
  • Fluent in RTL coding for DFx logic including lock-up latches, clock gates, and scan anchors.
  • Able to translate system and safety requirements into concrete constraints on package architecture, DFT insertion, and support test engineering with planning, patterns, and debug.
  • Comfortable working in a cross functional role that extends beyond DFT, including low power designs with multiple clock domains.
  • Knowledge of fault models including Stuck-at, Transition, Gate-Exhaustive, Path Delay, IDDQ, and Cell Aware.
  • Exposure to post-silicon testing and tester pattern debug are major assets.
  • Experience with Fault Campaigns a plus.

What We Need

  • Define DFx strategy for multi chiplet packages from architecture through high volume production.
  • 10+ years of experience working across multiple teams and multiple companies to coordinate test, yield, and quality efforts.
  • Feed lessons learned back into next generation SiP architectures, DFT strategy, and test content.
  • MBIST, LBIST, IST planning, implementation, and verification.
  • JTAG, Scan Compression, and ASST implementation.
  • ATPG and test coverage analysis using industry standard tools.

What You Will Learn

  • How to bring a SiP to high volume, automotive grade production.
  • How chiplets, RISC V CPUs, AI accelerators, and die to die links come together in a unified automotive platform.
  • How to trade off package architecture, DFT, and test cost to hit aggressive performance, quality, and reliability targets.

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S. As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency.   • Monitor services and applications using defined SLIs, SLOs, dashboards, alerts, and other observability tools; continuously improve the detection, diagnosis, and resolution of operational issues.

  • Manage production incidents and service disruptions, including on-call response, troubleshooting, service restoration, root-cause analysis, and post-incident corrective actions.
  • Execute application and infrastructure releases through established deployment pipelines, including promotion through staging and production, validation, rollback, and release-related troubleshooting.
  • Manage the operational lifecycle of deployed infrastructure, including upgrades, patching, configuration changes, maintenance, and technology refreshes.
  • Assess and improve service resilience through capacity planning, performance testing, failure-mode analysis, disaster recovery, backup, failover, and recovery testing.
  • Identify and address reliability risks and operational technical debt by using reliability metrics, incident trends, capacity data, and service health indicators to prioritize improvements.
  • Automate operational activities using an everything-as-code approach to improve consistency, repeatability, testing, deployment, recovery, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with platform engineering and application teams to identify operational requirements, provide feedback on reusable infrastructure building blocks, and continuously improve the reliability and operability of the environment.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance.
  • Bachelor's Degree and 8 years of experience, or a High School diploma/equivalent and 12 years of experience.
  • 7+ years hands-on experience in site reliability engineering, DevOps, or production systems engineering.
  • Hands-on experience operating in AWS Commercial and AWS GovCloud, including OpenShift (ROSA) or comparable Kubernetes-based platforms
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform and Ansible/Ansible Tower.
  • Experience with CI/CD platforms GitLab and Jenkins, including reliability gating and deployment automation.
  • Proficient in Linux and Windows Server administration
  • Experience with enterprise observability tools such as Dynatrace, Datadog, Splunk and Open Telemetry.
  • Demonstrated ownership of an SLI/SLO and alerting program, including error budgets, alert rationalization, and noise reduction.
  • Scripting/automation proficiency in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or Go.
  • Experience operating in federal or regulated environments (FISMA, FedRAMP, NIST 800-53).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • AWS Solutions Architect, AWS DevOps Engineer, or AWS SysOps certification
  • Red Hat Certified Specialist in ROSA, Red Hat Certified System Administrator in OpenShift
  • Azure Administrator Associate, GCP Associate Cloud Engineer certification
  • Dynatrace Associate, Datadog Log Management Fundamentals certification
  • GitLab CI/CD Associate certification, Certified Jenkins Engineer (CJE)
  • Terraform Associate certification

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. StackAdapt is looking for an Employment Counsel to join our growing Legal team. Reporting to the Senior Director, Employment Counsel, you will help support the employment law function across Canada and, as needed, our other key international markets. This role is well-suited to an employment lawyer with 3+ years of hands-on experience looking to take on broad ownership across advisory work, compliance, dispute resolution, and cross-functional projects at a fast-growing, global technology company.

You'll work closely with our People & Culture (P&C) team and business leaders on the full employment lifecycle, from hiring through to termination, while helping build scalable, compliant frameworks as StackAdapt continues to expand internationally.

StackAdapt is a Remote First company. We are open to candidates located in Canada for this position.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Provide day-to-day employment law advisory support for Canada (all provinces, as applicable), with additional support to other jurisdictions such as the UK, Germany, Australia, and Singapore, working with local outside counsel as needed.
  • Manage and help resolve employment standards complaints, human rights complaints, and demand letters, and support litigation strategy and outside counsel instruction where required.
  • Partner with the People & Culture team on workplace investigations, performance management, accommodations, leaves of absence, and terminations.
  • Draft and maintain employment agreements, policies, and handbooks across supported jurisdictions.
  • Support key employment-related compliance projects and initiatives as the company scales, helping build sustainable and efficient processes for the Legal and P&C teams.

  • Minimum 3+ years of relevant employment law experience, with some of that at a law firm where you advised on Canadian employment matters and handled employment demands and litigation; experience with other jurisdictions (e.g., US, UK, Australia, Singapore, Germany) is an asset.

About the Role:

CrowdStrike Intelligence is seeking a motivated security researcher with excellent technical skills to join the Advanced Research Team (ART). ART is responsible for researching and publishing on topics related to information security, providing technical expertise to other teams within CrowdStrike Intelligence, developing tools to support analysts in their day-to-day duties, and collecting technical artifacts about adversary activity.

Aside from working on longer-term research and collection projects, ART security researchers will be required to provide unique solutions on short notice to serve ad-hoc needs by other teams within CrowdStrike Intelligence.

raw.title: Senior HR & Operations Coordinator (LATAM only)
raw.excerpt: This is a remote position. The HR & Operations Coordinator supports day-to-day HR and operational processes across a remote organization.
raw.description:
This is a remote position.

The HR & Operations Coordinator supports day-to-day HR and operational processes across a remote organization. The position is responsible for maintaining accurate records, coordinating performance reviews, conducting candidate interviews, supporting payroll preparation, managing recurring HR activities, and ensuring operational follow-ups are completed.

This role communicates directly with contractors, candidates, clients, managers, and internal departments in both English and Spanish. Recruitment is an important part of the position, particularly interviews and candidate coordination, but it is not the role’s exclusive focus.

Position Scope

The position supports approximately:

  • Around 50-100 active contractors.
  • 10-50 active clients.
  • 5-20 performance reviews during an average month.

Performance-review volume may vary based on first-month, third-month, sixth-month, annual, and performance-improvement review schedules.

Key Responsibilities

HR Operations and Contractor Management
  • Coordinate contractor onboarding and required documentation.
  • Maintain accurate contractor, contract, attendance, training, and HR records.
  • Track absences, schedule changes, applicable bonuses, birthdays, work anniversaries, and recognition activities.
  • Support monthly payroll preparation by gathering and validating required information.
  • Coordinate training activities and related follow-ups.
  • Support contractor relations and internal HR communications.
  • Handle confidential HR, payroll, candidate, client, and performance information appropriately.

Performance Reviews and Client Feedback
  • Coordinate first-month, third-month, sixth-month, and annual performance reviews.
  • Schedule and facilitate performance-review meetings with contractors, clients, managers, and QA representatives.
  • Communicate directly with clients to collect and clarify contractor feedback.
  • Prepare meeting summaries, performance documentation, and follow-up communications.
  • Track pending reviews, action items, improvement areas, and deadlines.
  • Support Performance Improvement Plans and other performance-related processes.
  • Escalate serious performance concerns or matters requiring disciplinary action to management.

Recruitment and Interviews
  • Support job posting, candidate screening, assessments, interviews, and hiring coordination.
  • Conduct individual HR interviews and facilitate group interviews.
  • Evaluate candidates’ English communication, professional background, presentation, professionalism, and overall alignment with available opportunities.
  • Coordinate interviews with hiring managers, clients, and technical team members.
  • Prepare clear and objective interview notes.
  • Document candidate progress, outcomes, and decisions in Zoho Recruit.
  • Follow up with candidates regarding interviews, assessments, pending information, and next steps.
  • Present qualified candidates to clients and coordinate selection-process follow-ups.

Operations, Systems, and Data Management
  • Coordinate follow-ups between HR, Operations, QA, IT, Recruitment, and management.
  • Track recurring responsibilities, deadlines, and pending operational items.
  • Maintain internal procedures, SOPs, operational guides, and historical records.
  • Maintain accurate information across Zoho Recruit, Zoho CRM, spreadsheets, and other internal systems.
  • Perform data cleanup and correct incomplete, duplicated, or outdated records.
  • Assist with operational reports, recruitment metrics, and KPI tracking.
  • Identify repetitive or inefficient processes and recommend workflow improvements.
  • Support approved Zoho automations, CRM projects, and other operational initiatives.

Process Ownership and Management Approval

The coordinator independently owns the day-to-day coordination, documentation, and follow-up of:

  • Contractor onboarding.
  • Performance-review scheduling and documentation.
  • HR and group interviews.
  • Candidate and assessment follow-ups.
  • HR calendars, recurring activities, and operational trackers.
  • Contractor, candidate, client, and performance-record maintenance.
  • Payroll-support information and absence tracking.
  • Client feedback collection.
  • Training coordination and cross-departmental follow-ups.

Management approval is required for:

  • Final hiring decisions and contractor offers.
  • Compensation, budget, bonus, or payroll changes.
  • Disciplinary actions, PIP terms, or contract terminations.
  • Exceptions to schedules, policies, contracts, or established non-negotiables.
  • Final job descriptions and recruitment budgets.
  • Major workflow, automation, system-permission, or policy changes.
  • Client contract, service-scope, or financial commitments.

The coordinator is responsible for gathering information, maintaining accurate documentation, recommending next steps, and keeping processes moving while escalating decisions outside the role’s authority.


Requirements

  • Minimum of three years of relevant experience in HR Operations, Human Resources, Operations Coordination, Recruitment Coordination, or a similar role.
  • Four or more years of relevant experience preferred.
  • C1 or advanced professional English proficiency.
  • Strong professional communication skills in Spanish.
  • Ability to communicate directly and professionally with English-speaking clients through email and virtual meetings.
  • Hands-on experience conducting candidate interviews.
  • Experience coordinating performance reviews and maintaining performance documentation.
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
