Job Description

What starts with YOU, moves the world!

Hyster-Yale Materials Handling, Inc, a world-class manufacturer of industrial lift trucks, has an outstanding opportunity for an exceptional and talented Salesforce Technical Architect.This position may be based at our Americas Headquarters in Greenville, North Carolina, or may be performed remotely.

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Technical Architect to lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale Salesforce solutions. This role requires a strategic technology leader with deep Salesforce expertise, strong stakeholder management capabilities, and a proven track record of delivering scalable, secure, and integrated CRM solutions.

The ideal candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders, driving platform innovation, architectural governance, and technical excellence across the Salesforce ecosystem.

What you will do:

  • Partner with business leaders, product owners, and IT teams to understand day-to-day needs and translate them into practical Salesforce solutions.

  • Design and guide Salesforce solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Manufacturing Cloud, and the broader Salesforce Platform.

  • Lead architecture discussions, review solution designs, and ensure work aligns with enterprise standards, security requirements, and platform best practices.

  • Support the delivery of Salesforce enhancements, integrations, data migrations, and system improvements from planning through implementation.

  • Collaborate with developers, administrators, architects, vendors, and external partners to troubleshoot issues and deliver reliable CRM capabilities.

  • Create and maintain architecture documentation, technical designs, roadmaps, and implementation guidance to support consistent delivery.

  • Identify opportunities to improve platform performance, reduce technical debt, strengthen security, and expand Salesforce capabilities across the organization.

Who you are:

  • A collaborative leader who can guide teams, build trust, and bring people together around shared priorities.

  • A clear communicator who can explain technical information to both IT and business audiences.

  • A service-minded problem solver who stays focused on customer needs, business impact, and timely resolution.

  • A proactive planner who can manage competing priorities, anticipate risks, and follow through on commitments.

  • A continuous improvement mindset with the flexibility to adapt, coach others, and support change across the organization.

What you will need:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.

  • Experience: 10+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience and 7+ years in Salesforce Architecture roles.

Skills, Experience & Abilities

  • Salesforce Certified Application Architect certification required.

  • Strong expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, APIs, mobile capabilities, sharing and visibility models, and Single Sign-On (SSO).

  • Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale Salesforce solutions, integrations, and platform enhancements across global or multi-region environments.

  • Experience designing scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce architecture that supports business processes, data quality, system performance, and long-term platform growth.

  • Working knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and architecture governance.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate complex concepts clearly to business stakeholders, technical teams, and external partners.

  • Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, prioritize competing needs, and drive work forward in a fast-paced environment.

  • Collaborative team player with excellent communication, problem-solving, and relationship-building skills across different teams, regions, and cultures.

Preferred Skills, Experience & Abilities

  • Experience designing Salesforce integrations with middleware, REST/SOAP APIs, enterprise integration patterns, and telephony/CTI solutions.

  • Ability to connect Salesforce with CPQ, ERP, marketing automation, analytics, and other enterprise platforms.

  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data architecture, data migration, and platform optimization.

  • Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Revenue Cloud/CPQ, Marketing Cloud, and Agentforce capabilities.

  • Manufacturing Cloud experience preferred.

  • Preferred Salesforce certifications include System Architect, Technical Architect, Integration Architect, Data Architect, Sharing and Visibility Architect, or Platform Developer II.

Who we are:

Hyster-Yale Materials Handling, Inc., designs, engineers, manufactures, sells and services a comprehensive line of lift trucks, aftermarket parts and technology and energy solutions that are transforming the way the world moves materials from Port to Home. As a global leader in the materials handling industry, Hyster-Yale Materials Handling, Inc, has been building relationships with our customers, suppliers, dealers and employees for over 100 years. For more information about a career with Hyster-Yale, please visit hyster-yalecareers.com.

Knock is redefining the home buying and selling experience, and we’re only getting started! We’re a passionate team of industry experts who knew there had to be a better, simpler way for people to navigate the journey between homes. That people-first mindset is core to how we operate, and why Knock has been honored as one of Inc.’s Best Workplaces six times in the past seven years.

We bring that mindset into the work we do every day. The Knock Bridge Loan™ empowers homebuyers to ‘buy before they sell’, by unlocking the equity in their current home, giving them greater convenience, certainty, and competitiveness.

Founded in 2015, Knock has grown into a trusted partner for thousands of homebuyers and a network of 60,000+ loan officers and agents across the country. Backed by top investors like Foundry Group, Trinity Capital, and the National Association of Realtors, we’ve built a reputation for innovation and trust, earning 900+ five-star Zillow and Trustpilot reviews and an A+ BBB rating.

Join our growing team and help shape the future of homebuying! To learn more, visit Knock.com

Mortgage Account Executive – Remote, anywhere in the US

We are seeking a sales-driven, partner-obsessed Account Executive to join our high-performing sales team. This role is ideal for someone with lending experience who brings strong outbound sales capability to generate new business for Knock. In this hunting role, you will be responsible for outbound sales and driving adoption of our first-of-its-kind Knock Bridge Loan™— a unique solution that enables homeowners to unlock the equity in their current home to purchase their next one.

As an Account Executive (AE) at Knock, you will focus on outbound prospecting and partner enablement with lending and broker partners, driving loan application volume through consistent outreach, education, and relationship building. You will operate in a B2B2C environment and play a critical role in introducing the first-of-its-kind Knock Bridge Loan™ to new partners. Your work will directly support our mission to modernize the homeownership journey.

Compensation and Benefits

Our Compensation Philosophy: As a fully remote (U.S.-based) workforce, our goal is to ensure that all Knockstars are fairly compensated. The salary range below is a good faith estimate for this position and is provided in accordance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws.

The base salary range for this position is $55,000 - $60,000 USD. In addition, this role is eligible for an uncapped incentive plan (bonus).

The on-target earnings (OTE), base salary + bonus, are $189,000 USD and are performance-based and not guaranteed.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute outbound cold outreach to generate interest and convert lending prospects into active lending partners that drive loan applications
  • Host regular meetings and training sessions with loan officers, team leads, branch managers, brokers, and agents to share updates, review performance, and optimize use of Knock’s offerings
  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly goals for driving new business within an assigned territory
  • Partner with lenders and brokers to drive new loan applications for Knock
  • Lead operational and strategic initiatives that grow top-of-funnel activity and drive both new and repeat applications
  • Achieve monthly loan application sales targets, with a minimum expectation of 70 applications per month
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to deliver a seamless experience for our partners and their customers
  • Track, analyze, and report on key performance metrics including outreach activity, partnerships, leads, and loan applications
  • Champion collaboration and foster a positive, team-oriented work environment

What You’ll Bring

  • Recent lending experience or an active NMLS license required
  • Recent experience working directly with lenders
  • Experience in SaaS sales is a strong plus
  • Ability to execute cold outbound outreach and build a healthy sales pipeline
  • Proven, measurable success in meeting or exceeding sales targets
  • Creative and strategic thinker with a passion for growing partnerships and improving partner experiences
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to confidently engage senior stakeholders
  • Performance-driven mindset with a focus on partner success
  • Team-oriented attitude with a passion for supporting and uplifting others
  • Receptive to coaching and open to giving/receiving constructive feedback

raw.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Finance
raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart's Customer Experience & Operations organization is at the heart of how we support the millions of customers, shoppers, and partners who rely on our platform every day. Within that organization, the CX Technology Programs team is responsible for driving the development and deployment of technology solutions that meaningfully improve the support experience at scale.

We are looking for a CX Technology Program Manager to join a small, high-impact team working at the intersection of automation, operations, and product execution. This role sits within a team of three — two individual contributors and a people manager — and will play a critical role in bringing structure, coordination, and momentum to an ambitious chatbot automation program. With 14 automations currently in active development across Shopper and Customer support programs and significant monthly cost savings on the line, this is a role where your work will have immediate, measurable business impact. If you thrive in fast-moving environments, are energized by complexity, and know how to drive programs forward without waiting for perfect conditions, this role is for you.

About the Job

  • Own end-to-end planning and coordination for a portfolio of chatbot automation initiatives spanning both Shopper and Customer support programs, ensuring timelines, dependencies, and stakeholders are aligned across concurrent workstreams.
  • Drive program execution in an environment where priorities shift and the roadmap evolves — you'll be the connective tissue between technical teams, operations, and leadership, keeping work moving and risks visible.
  • Build and maintain the operational infrastructure for the CX Technology Programs team, including program tracking, status reporting, and cross-functional communication rhythms that give stakeholders confidence in the work underway.
  • Partner closely with product, engineering, and CX operations teams to scope, sequence, and launch automation solutions, translating business goals into clear plans with defined milestones and accountability.
  • Identify gaps, surface blockers early, and propose solutions — this team is currently under-resourced on the planning and coordination side, and you will be stepping in to immediately add structure and move critical work forward.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, technical program management, or operations program management, ideally within a technology, e-commerce, or customer experience organization.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent programs with cross-functional stakeholders, including the ability to build and maintain program plans, track dependencies, and communicate status clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working on or alongside automation, AI, or chatbot technology programs, with a working understanding of how these solutions are scoped, built, and deployed in an operational context.
  • Proficiency with project and program management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Monday.com, or similar) and comfort using data to track progress and communicate impact.
  • Proven ability to operate independently and create structure in ambiguous environments, including stepping into under-resourced programs and quickly establishing clarity and momentum.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within a customer support or CX technology environment, with familiarity with support operations metrics, tooling ecosystems (e.g., Salesforce, Zendesk, or similar), or automation-driven cost reduction programs.
  • Background working in a high-growth or fast-paced technology company where priorities evolve quickly and cross-functional coordination spans multiple teams simultaneously.
  • Experience contributing to or managing programs with measurable financial impact, such as cost savings targets, efficiency initiatives, or automation ROI tracking.
  • Comfort engaging with technical concepts and product development processes, with the ability to have informed conversations with engineering and product partners without needing deep technical expertise yourself.

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.

CA, NY, CT, NJ
$147,000—$155,000 USD
WA
$140,000—$148,000 USD
OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI
$134,000—$141,500 USD
All other states
$122,000—$129,000 USD

description: Join the Tilt teamAt Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss.

raw.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Kotlin), Blipay
raw.excerpt: Join the Tilt teamAt Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss.
raw.description:
Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

About Blipay

Blipay is Tilt's Brazilian business unit. In Brazil, credit is still decided by a score that summarizes someone's past and ignores their present. We do it differently — using Open Finance and real-time financial signals, we look at people's actual financial lives and say yes to people the traditional market writes off too quickly. Over 1 million customers. Salary advance, FGTS, consignado. Products that put money in people's hands when they need it.

The Opportunity: Senior Software Engineer, Backend

You'll work close to the product here — no intermediary layer between you and the problem. You're part of the conversation about what to build, you build it, and you watch it reach production. The loop is short and the stakes are real: salary advance, FGTS, and consignado move money in the lives of working people every month, so what you ship has direct consequences for someone. We're looking for a senior backend engineer who takes real ownership of their work, thinks carefully about how systems should behave, and wants to collaborate closely with product, credit, and compliance — not in isolation from them.

This role is remote. The team gathers at our Campinas office twice a year, and as part of Tilt you'll join two global offsites annually — past locations include Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Build and scale the backend systems behind salary advance, FGTS, and consignado lending — with a clear eye on reliability and correctness

  • Develop and refine the APIs that power an instant in-app experience, with the precision those transactions demand

  • Work on the integrations that make payroll-linked and FGTS lending function — systems where uptime isn't optional

  • Collaborate directly with product, credit, compliance, and analytics — your technical perspective shapes the work

  • Contribute to code reviews, technical discussions, and team standards around quality, security, and operational excellence

  • Share what you know with junior engineers and be the kind of teammate that makes the work better for everyone around you

Why You're a Great Fit

  • 4+ years of backend engineering experience with demonstrated ownership of meaningful work — if you're close and the rest fits, let's talk

  • Strong experience with Kotlin and/or Java

  • Solid working knowledge of AWS, PostgreSQL, and ECS

  • Experience building consumer-facing systems at real transaction volumes

  • Fluent Portuguese and advanced English (C1) — part of the Tilt team operates outside Brazil and collaboration happens in English, written and spoken

  • Comfortable using AI-powered development tools as a genuine productivity lever (we use Claude; similar experience transfers)

  • Fintech, lending, payments, or regulated environment experience is a strong plus

Why Blipay

CLT employment with full benefits — health insurance, VR/VA meal allowances, and a home office stipend. Competitive compensation and Tilt equity. Remote-first with a team that spans 14 countries and 12 time zones. Direct access to leadership — good ideas travel fast here, and growth follows contribution, not tenure. And twice a year, the whole company gets together in person somewhere worth going.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

raw.description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About The Role

Avalere Health is seeking a Vice President level candidate to join our Evidence and Strategy practice within its Advisory capability. Our cross-functional, US and EU based Evidence & Strategy practice provides exceptional consultation, evidence, and insights on key aspects of healthcare – including patient-centric HEOR, quality of care measures, shared decision-making, value-based care, and health equity – to shape strategy for our clients.
Our mission is to improve quality of care, craft data-driven strategies, drive patient-centric outcomes, and ultimately provide the highest value to all our partners, including life sciences companies, payers, providers, and patient advocates. Our work is focused on 3 intersecting strategic pillars: Patient-Centric Value, Evidence & Analytics, and Healthcare Strategy. Underlying all work is a deep commitment to data-driven insights.
The Managing Director role within Advisory is a senior advisory leader and is part of the extended leadership team. Within our Evidence and Strategy practice the Managing Director role is a key member of the leadership team and leads thought-leadership and mentorship with colleagues across the practice. As a Managing Director in Evidence and Strategy, you will support client engagements that inform business and evidence strategy related to the strategic direction and execution of projects in partnership with the cross-functional teams to generate data to answer decision-makers complex questions on the value, impact and program evaluation of clients’ products and disease areas of focus.
The ideal candidate has current or considerable previous consulting experience with deep knowledge of engaging with life sciences clients from a business development perspective in support of developing and interpreting evidence and communicating value for life sciences products. In addition, as a leader in the practice you will support, mentor, and contribute to designing, measuring and evaluating interventions, initiatives and implementation from all perspectives. Furthermore, you will have a proven-track record of conducting and leading healthcare research studies for clients across the life sciences ecosystem.

What you'll do

  • Demonstrates superior consulting acumen, deep client relationships and anticipates client needs and impacts of healthcare landscape changes
  • Leads in generating business with new clients and growing business with existing clients. This role is dedicated ~75% to business development and ~25% to project delivery.
  • Manage multiple clients and short- and long-term deliverables to ensure that Avalere's knowledge and expertise are available to meet client needs.
  • Lead as a Project Lead or Executive Sponsor to a range of projects and project teams including creating protocols and evaluation plans, executing strategic and tactical projects, and preparing/presenting through manuscripts, posters, presentations.
  • Presenting, both formally and informally as well as to clients and at external meetings, the results of research to a diverse group of stakeholders.
  • Develops and executes a range of projects, including writing RFPs, vendor selection, and project management, including budget and timelines.
  • Proficient at mixed-methods research and the development of strategic plans, studies, and analyses to support patient access and value-based outcomes, all within a highly matrixed team environment.
  • Building and fulfilling integrated RWE generation and strategic plans in close collaboration within and across Avalere and Avalere Health.

About you

  • Advanced degree in health policy, public policy, healthcare management, public health, public administration, health economics, business administration, with a relevant discipline with 8-10 years of relevant experience OR an undergraduate degree in the same or similar areas with 12+ years of relevant experience.
  • Examples of relevant work experience including and prioritizing: consulting firms, with focus areas of pharmaceutical, emerging biotechnology, diagnostics and/or digital health, health plans and providers, and the healthcare industry at large.
  • 5+ years of management/supervisory experience with excellent leadership/mentoring skills in developing staff.
  • Advanced proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite.
  • Solid writing and storytelling skills as a foundation for professional business communication.

Additional skills and competencies

  • Ability to establish personal credibility as a strategic, RWE expert with clients.
  • Significant and sustained project management experience that includes interacting with and presenting to senior-level executives and/or health policy leaders.
  • Proven situational leadership skills and the ability to motivate and generate enthusiasm with individuals across all levels of the organization.
  • Exemplary interpersonal skills that translate into positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
  • Solid communication skills including the ability to concisely explain complicated concepts to executives within and outside of the firm.
  • Ability to analyze and understand RWE trends from the perspective of multiple stakeholders and translate related business implications.
  • Commitment to working in a team environment with an emphasis on collaboration and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and analytic skills with the ability to apply knowledge outside of one’s immediate functional area.

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.

Role Summary

Renew Capital is seeking a Senior Data Officer to lead the design and development of our in-house data platform. This role will drive the creation of proprietary models, infrastructure and scalable tools that underpin our investment approach. The candidate must combine deep technical expertise in data science with leadership capacity to grow and manage a cross-disciplinary team. raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is based in Malaysia. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Malaysia office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

About the Role

We're looking for a strategic and collaborative Sales Enablement Manager to help scale our go-to-market organization. In this role, you'll partner across Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Experience, Recruiting, and Learning & Development to ensure our customer-facing teams have the knowledge, tools, processes, and content they need to deliver an exceptional customer experience and drive business results.

You'll serve as the connective tissue across our GTM organization—translating strategy into execution, identifying performance gaps, enabling successful product launches, and creating scalable programs that improve sales effectiveness and customer outcomes.

If you enjoy solving sales challenges, influencing cross-functional teams, and building programs that have measurable impact, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

Sales Enablement & Training

  • Design, build, and continuously improve onboarding programs to accelerate new-hire ramp time.
  • Develop ongoing training programs that strengthen product knowledge, consultative selling, objection handling, and customer experience.
  • Create certifications, learning paths, coaching resources, and sales enablement programs.
  • Analyze sales performance trends and identify opportunities for targeted enablement initiatives.

Data & Feedback Loop

  • Analyze conversion, win/loss, and retention data to identify what's working and feed it back into training
  • Review call recordings and customer interactions to surface best practices from top performers and turn them into repeatable playbooks
  • Track and report on enablement-specific metrics and their downstream impact on conversion or win rate

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate positioning, messaging, and competitive insights into practical sales playbooks, talk tracks, FAQs, and customer-facing resources.
  • Collaborate with Product Management to prepare customer-facing teams for product launches by developing training, enablement content, and readiness plans.
  • Work closely with Marketing to ensure campaign messaging is consistently reflected throughout the customer journey.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to support CRM adoption, process improvements, sales workflows, and operational readiness.
  • Collaborate with Customer Experience and Customer Success teams to improve onboarding, retention, upsell, and support experiences.
  • Gather frontline feedback and communicate customer insights back to Product, Marketing, and Sales Leadership to continuously improve our GTM strategy.

Content & Communication

  • Create and refine high-converting playbooks, call scripts, objection-handling guides, and cross-sell/upsell matrices for the sales team.
  • Own the organization and maintenance of sales enablement content, including playbooks, product documentation, competitive battle cards, sales presentations, and knowledge resources.
  • Ensure customer-facing teams have easy access to current, accurate, and actionable enablement materials.
  • Package customer proof points, case studies, and FAQs into reusable assets teams can pull from in the moment
  • Develop scalable communication plans for product launches, process updates, and organizational changes.

Tools & Process

  • Own or co-own enablement tooling (e.g., CRM/helpdesk macros, content/asset libraries, call recording platforms) so teams can find the right resource in seconds, not minutes
  • Partner with RevOps to keep CRM data clean and process consistent across teams

What You'll Bring

  • Prior experience carrying an individual sales quota or serving in a consultative customer-facing role (Sales, Business Development, Account Management, Customer Success, Retail Leadership, or similar). You understand firsthand what it takes to build trust with customers, navigate objections, and operate in a performance-driven environment.
  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing revenue role and/or Sales Enablement, Revenue Enablement, Sales Operations, Product Marketing, or a related GTM function.
  • Experience designing and scaling enablement programs that improve onboarding, sales readiness, product adoption, or customer experience.
  • Proven ability to build trusted partnerships across Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Experience, and executive leadership.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and influence audiences ranging from frontline employees to senior leaders.
  • An analytical mindset with experience using performance metrics, customer feedback, and business insights to identify opportunities and measure the impact of enablement initiatives.
  • A builder's mentality—you enjoy creating scalable programs, playbooks, and processes that help teams perform at their best.
  • High emotional intelligence and credibility. You listen before prescribing solutions, seek to understand the realities of frontline teams, and earn trust through empathy, collaboration, and thoughtful execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a direct-to-consumer, retail, consumer technology, marketplace, or high-growth environment.
  • Experience supporting product launches and go-to-market initiatives across multiple customer-facing teams.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar), learning management systems, and enablement tools such as Gong, Highspot, Seismic, WorkRamp, or similar platforms.
  • Experience coaching managers or facilitating leadership development programs.

Success in This Role

After your first 60-days, you will have:

  • Built scalable onboarding and ongoing enablement programs that improve sales readiness and consistency.
  • Successfully enabled multiple product launches across customer-facing teams.
  • Established trusted partnerships across Sales, Product, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Customer Experience.
  • Increased adoption of key sales processes, tools, and messaging.
  • Demonstrated measurable improvements in ramp time, productivity, customer experience, or sales effectiveness.
  • Become a strategic partner who helps connect business strategy with frontline execution.

Why This Role Matters

Our customers experience our brand through every interaction with our teams. This role helps ensure those interactions are consistent, informed, and customer-centric. By connecting strategy with execution and enabling our teams to perform at their best, you'll play a critical role in helping us scale our business while delivering an outstanding customer experience.

Why You'll Love Inspira

  • Amazing people with a great vision and values
  • Mission-driven team culture focused on student success
  • Your work directly impacts the lives and careers of students across the globe
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, base plans 100% employer paid
  • Pre-tax benefits (FSA, DCFSA, HSA, Commuter)
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • 401(k) with company match

For more information about our company, please visit our website: Inspira Education Group.

Inspira Education Group does not discriminate based on race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in providing employment opportunities and benefits.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Digital Learning Developer

Role purpose

Build accessible and engaging digital learning resources using Articulate Rise, Storyline, H5P and related tools, supported by appropriate image sourcing, preparation and manipulation.

Key responsibilities

  • Build digital courses from approved learning-design storyboards.
  • Develop content using Rise, Storyline and H5P.
  • Configure interactions, scenarios, feedback, branching, states, triggers and variables at the level required by the project.
  • Source suitable licensed images and maintain accurate source and licence records.
  • Crop, edit, optimise and manipulate images for digital delivery.
  • Integrate graphics, animation, video, audio and voice-over.
  • Apply templates, brand guidelines and development standards.
  • Implement accessibility requirements within the selected authoring tools.
  • Configure, package and test SCORM content.
  • Conduct technical self-checks and rectify identified issues.
  • Maintain clean, organised and transferable source files.
  • Collaborate with Learning Designers, graphic designers, multimedia specialists and quality reviewers.

Essential requirements

  • Demonstrated experience developing complete digital learning resources.
  • Strong capability in Articulate Rise.
  • Working or advanced capability in Articulate Storyline.
  • Experience developing activities in H5P.
  • Competence in image sourcing, licence checking, cropping, manipulation and optimisation.
  • Understanding of interaction design and learner feedback.
  • Ability to work accurately from an approved storyboard.
  • Understanding of responsive design and digital accessibility.
  • Experience publishing and testing SCORM packages.
  • Strong troubleshooting and quality self-review capability.
  • Reliable file naming, version control and source-file management.

Desirable requirements

  • Advanced Storyline variables, triggers, states and branching.
  • Experience with simulations or virtual workplace experiences.
  • Understanding of LMS behaviour and SCORM completion and tracking settings.
  • Basic HTML or CSS knowledge.
  • Experience with audio and video editing.
  • Experience in adult learning, VET or workplace training.
  • Familiarity with WCAG 2.1 or 2.2 Level AA.
  • Experience using approved AI tools to support production while retaining human review.

POSITION OVERVIEW

MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled business services companies in the USA, with a strong call center footprint and operations that extend across multiple countries. We deliver Customer Experience (CX), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), and Anything-as-a-Service (XaaS) cloud technology solutions across a wide range of industries, including healthcare, retail, government, education, telecom, technology e-commerce, and financial services. Our contact centers are powered by both on-site and remote agents, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance customer journeys, drive scalability and reduce costs.

At MCI we are committed to fostering an environment where professionals can build meaningful careers, access continuous learning and development opportunities and contribute to the success of a globally expanding, industry-leading organization.

We are seeking enthusiastic Remote Outbound Sales Agents to join our virtual sales team. This role is ideal for individuals who are confident communicators, persuasive, and driven to meet sales goals all while working from home.

To be considered for this role, you must complete a full application on our company careers page, including all screening questions and a brief pre-employment test.

  • Previous outbound sales or call center experience preferred.

  • Self-motivated and results oriented.

In 2019, Marlowe Companies Inc. (MCI) was named by Inc. Magazine as Iowa’s Fastest Growing Company in the State of Iowa and was named the 452nd Fastest Growing Privately Company in the USA, making the coveted top 500 for the first time. raw.description:
About Chainlink
Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at .

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Dev Services team, you will play a key role in expanding developer capabilities across the CRE platform by building scalable platform services and developer tooling. You will drive improvements that reduce operational silos, strengthen platform reliability, and deliver a best-in-class developer experience for internal engineering teams and external developers.

Your Impact

  • Deliver core capabilities across the CLI, Go SDK, TypeScript SDK, and frontend services that enable developers to build more effectively on the CRE platform.

  • Improve vertical and horizontal scalability across critical platform services.

  • Increase workflow execution durability and platform reliability for developer-facing systems.

  • Reduce knowledge silos by expanding ownership across critical components of the CRE platform.

  • Elevate the developer experience through high-quality platform APIs, tooling, and SDK improvements.

  • Strengthen operational resilience by increasing shared ownership of production systems and on-call responsibilities.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience developing and operating software systems at scale.

  • Built and maintained production backend applications and APIs serving multiple stakeholders.

  • Experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems.

  • Advanced proficiency developing production software in Go.

  • Independently owned complex technical initiatives from design through production delivery while navigating ambiguous requirements.

  • Delivered high-quality implementations with strong engineering rigor and attention to reliability and quality.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with several of the following: data pipelines and processing, observability platforms, customer-facing applications or developer tools with a strong UX focus, large-scale SQL data systems, gRPC services, low-latency systems, or consensus algorithms.

  • Developed software in TypeScript and/or Solidity.

  • Demonstrated interest in blockchain and Web3 technologies.

  • Track record of partnering closely with product, sales, marketing, customer-facing teams, or directly with customers.

  • Experience building decentralized applications (dApps).

  • Experience developing banking infrastructure or other financial software.

All roles with Chainlink Labs are global and remote-based. Unless otherwise stated, we ask that you try to overlap some working hours with Eastern Standard Time (EST).

We carefully review all applications and aim to provide a response to every candidate within two weeks after the job posting closes. The closing date is listed on the job advert, so we encourage you to take the time to thoughtfully prepare your application. We want to fully consider your experience and skills, and you will hear from us regarding the status of your application shortly after the closing date.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Chainlink Labs is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us via this form.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants

Information collected and processed as part of your Chainlink Labs Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to our Recruiting Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Associate Attorney

Remote from Ireland or hybrid in our Dublin office

As a Business Development Representative, you seek out and engage “good fit” companies through strategic prospecting. To do this, you will generate new interest through calls, emails, and social media messaging.

When connecting with a prospect, you will learn about their business challenges to determine whether HubSpot will serve as a solution. When you have identified a qualified prospect, your goal is to concisely communicate the value of HubSpot and gain interest in a deeper conversation with an Account Executive.

You will have a working relationship with 2-3 Account Executives. Each day, you will collaborate with the Account Executives you support and your fellow BDRs to develop innovative strategies for uncovering new opportunities.

What are the responsibilities of a Business Development Representative?

In this full-time role, you will need to:

  • Conduct high-volume prospecting for qualified leads (new users and potential customers)
  • Work closely and collaboratively with Account Executives to develop and implement appropriate prospect strategies and plans
  • Schedule online product demonstrations for a qualified lead whilst ensuring you meet your monthly goals
  • Understand the customers’ needs and challenges using sales methodologies, i.e. BANT
  • Carry out market research to broaden the customer base of HubSpot

What are the role requirements?

  • The desire and commitment to be in Tech Sales
  • Sales/ prospecting experience and experience working in a high-growth, "scale-up" environment are not required, but are a plus
  • Fluency in English and any East or Central European language (Proficiency in Polish is preferred.)
  • A sharp focus on your goals and a strong approach to achieving them
  • The ability to deal with and address objections, and be open to being coached
  • Strong organisational and time management skills
  • Passion for helping businesses grow and curiosity about the tech industry

What's in it for you?

  • Hybrid working policy that suits your working preferences
  • Amazing colleagues to learn from, and having a mentor you can turn to
  • Interactive employee training and a month-long onboarding experience to help you get started
  • A clear career path with regular promotion tracks
  • An education allowance up to €4,250 per year and a free books program so you can keep on learning
  • Flexible paid vacation days on top of your annual 25 days paid time off
  • Mental health coaching and sessions (Modern Health app) and other health benefits, ie Life Assurance, long term illness cover, fitness reimbursement of up to €250

Please note: This is a role that we hire on an ongoing basis throughout the year. If you choose to apply for this role, your information will be reviewed by our recruiting team and we will reach out to you if your background matches an opening at this time or in the future.

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Individual compensation packages are determined using objective, role-related criteria, which may include skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range:
€45.000—€61.000 EUR

We know theconfidence gap and impostor syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

If you need accommodations or assistance due to a disability, please reach out to us using this form.

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

Massachusetts Applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Germany Applicants: (m/f/d) - link to HubSpot's Career Diversity page here.

India Applicants: link to HubSpot India's equal opportunity policy here.

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

Explore more:

  • HubSpot Careers
  • Life at HubSpot on Instagram

HubSpot may use AI to help screen or assess candidates, but all hiring decisions are always human. More information can be found here. By submitting your application, you agree that HubSpot may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. We may use CLEAR ID Verification during the hiring process to confirm your identity and help maintain a safe, secure, and trusted experience for all candidates. Refer to HubSpot's Recruiting Privacy Notice for details on data processing and your rights.
